What We Do

Insulation and Roofing Services

From taking out spray foam so a sale can go through, to a new loft of insulation or a full re-roof.

Spray Foam Removal

Open and closed cell foam taken off the rafters with the timber protected, so a surveyor or valuer can see the roof structure again.

See more

Loft Insulation

New insulation laid to depth between and over the joists, with the ventilation checked at the same time to keep the roof space dry.

See more

Superfoil Insulation

Multifoil insulation fixed across the rafters, a thin layer that suits loft rooms and dormers where depth is tight.

See more

Roof Insulation

Insulation fitted between the rafters of loft rooms and roof spaces, and replacement insulation once spray foam has come out.

Get a quote

New Roofs

Complete re-roofs with new battens, breathable membrane, tiles or slate, ridge, lead flashing and matching roofline.

See more

Roof Repairs

Slipped tiles, failed flashing, leaking valleys and storm damage, traced back to where the water gets in rather than patched over.

See more

See The Difference

Before and After

Three recent jobs, from how we found them to how we left them.

Before After
Loft Insulation

Stripped Back and Re-Insulated

This loft was cleared right back to the joists so the timbers and wiring could be seen and checked. New mineral wool then went down between and across the joists, with a boarded walkway left along the middle.

Drag the slider to compare the before and after.

New Roof

Weathered Tiles to a New Roof

The old concrete tiles were worn and patched. The roof was stripped from the scaffold and re-covered in new dark tiles, with the dormer re-tiled to match.

Animated between our own before and after photos of this roof.

Before After
Loft Insulation

A Full Loft, Laid to Depth

The rolls went in on the first day and were laid across the whole loft floor, around the struts and up to the eaves. The finished loft carries an even, deep layer from the gable wall to the hatch.

Drag the slider to compare the before and after.

Why Choose Next Generation Insulation

We would rather show you what is in your loft than tell you. Every job starts with a look at the roof structure, then a clear written price with no hidden costs.

  • You See It Before We Start

    Photos and video of your loft or roof, so you know exactly what needs doing and why.

  • A Written Price

    A clear written quotation with no hidden costs, explained in plain terms before any work begins.

  • Roofers and Insulation in One Team

    If a roof needs work once spray foam comes out, the same team repairs or replaces it.

  • Speak to Dean

    The founder answers the calls and deals with your job personally, from survey to sign-off.

  • Across the Midlands

    We cover the East and West Midlands, with spray foam removal across the UK, and take on work further afield, subject to terms.

About Us

The Team Behind Next Generation Insulation

Next Generation Insulation was started in Leicester by Dean Simpson. Before the business, Dean worked on property renovations and HMO conversions, which is where he met the roofers, joiners, plasterers and electricians who became the team behind it.

A lot of our work is for people with spray foam in the loft, a sale or remortgage held up, or an inherited home they need to sort. We look at the roof first, explain what we find in plain terms, and keep you updated until the job is signed off.

Dean SimpsonFounder, Next Generation Insulation
